question: How are coming and going attributed to Śiva during worship without denying omnipresence?
premises: Śiva is worshipped through the body of mantra.
Coming and going are spoken of in worship.
This is analogous to localized manifestation of the all-pervading.
inference: In worship, Śiva's coming and going occur through the medium of the mantra-body.
plain_english: Likewise, in the worship of Śiva, coming and going occur through the medium of the mantra-body.
